subject: Diagnose mcp-atlassian MCP server (missing all 6 env vars)
description: claude mcp list shows mcp-atlassian in .mcp.json is missing JIRA_URL/JIRA_USERNAME/JIRA_API_TOKEN/CONFLUENCE_URL/CONFLUENCE_USERNAME/CONFLUENCE_API_TOKEN. This blocks project-init's Phase 3 Confluence checklist read/write. Needs Marcel's Atlassian API token.
